# Organisation
> TechVerge Africa is a world-class technology company based in Kumasi, Ghana,
> building AI systems, digital infrastructure, and intelligent platforms for Africa
> and the world. Our robotics division (TVA Robotics) is conducting open research
> into efficient, low-cost, and general-purpose AI at the edge.

## Mission
We are not trying to make AI bigger. We are trying to make intelligence cheaper.

## Research Identity
"We are researching the economics and architecture of efficient machine intelligence."

## TVA Open Research Initiative

### What it is
The TVA Robotics Open Research Initiative investigates whether the computational
architecture of AI itself can be redesigned for efficiency. Rather than simply
compressing existing models, we explore fundamentally new ways to represent, process,
remember, and reason about information on low-cost edge hardware.

### Central Research Question
Can we develop a fundamentally more compute-efficient architecture for AI that achieves
useful perception, reasoning, memory, and decision-making on low-cost edge hardware?

### Primary Hypothesis (Falsifiable)
AI systems that combine persistent state, selective computation, adaptive inference,
efficient neural architectures, and multimodal world representations can achieve
competitive real-world task performance while requiring substantially less computation,
memory, energy, and connectivity than conventional large-model architectures.

### 8 Research Areas (19 Research Questions)
1. Rethinking the Transformer (RQ1-RQ4): Which mechanisms are essential vs. costly?
2. Persistent Intelligence (RQ5-RQ7): Can persistent world state replace recomputation?
3. Event-Driven Intelligence (RQ8-RQ10): Compute only when input warrants it
4. Intelligence per Watt (RQ11): Measuring efficiency, not just performance
5. Edge Intelligence (RQ12-RQ14): AI without cloud dependency
6. Multimodal Intelligence (RQ15-RQ16): Fusing vision, language, sensors on edge
7. Embodied Intelligence (RQ17-RQ19): AI for robots in unstructured environments
8. The Bigger Question: Do we need larger models or better architectures?

### Key Metrics Defined
- IE (Intelligence Efficiency) = Task Performance / Compute (FLOPs)
- IE_E (Energy Efficiency) = Task Performance / Energy (Joules)
- IE_C (Economic Efficiency) = Task Performance / Cost ($)

### EIEB Benchmark
The Edge Intelligence Efficiency Benchmark (EIEB) measures AI across 11 dimensions:
Task Capability, Compute, Memory, Latency, Energy, Power, Model Size, Cost,
Bandwidth, Robustness, Adaptability.

### Open to
Students, independent researchers, engineers, neuroscientists, mathematicians, and
anyone with curiosity and commitment to open science. No institution required.
